commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Aitor Manas (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is replaced by Aitor Manas.
88' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is awarded a second yellow by Jesus Manzano and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
85' A substitution has been made. Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) goes off and Javi Lopez comes on.

84' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' That's a clear yellow card. Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) goes into the book.
75' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) now unnecessarily receives yet another yellow card, which means only one thing for him: an early bath.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alberto Reina will be replaced by Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo).
71' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' The attendance is 17345.
69' 1 - 1 Lucas Boye (Alaves) scores from a free kick after smashing the ball over the defensive wall and into the top left corner of the goal!
68' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Alaves win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
67' David Carmo (Real Oviedo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jesus Manzano blows for a foul.
66' The corner is swung in but Oviedo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Oviedo.

65' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
64' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
64' Toni Martinez (Alaves) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
63' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) commits a foul and Jesus Manzano immediately signals a free kick.
62' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carles Alena departs the field of play to be replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
62' Lucas Boye (Alaves) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky!
61' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

61' Aaron Escandell pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
59' He should have scored! Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
59' Dangerous play by Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo). Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
56' 0 - 1 What a hit! Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 0:1.
55' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Antonio Sivera with a brilliant diving save!
54' Here is a change. Eric Bailly is going off and Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves gives the last tactical orders to David Carmo (Real Oviedo).
54' The substitution is prepared. Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Josip Brekalo.
52' Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
48' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Lucas Boye (Alaves), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
46' Half-time substitution. Eduardo Coudet decided to make a change. Calebe (Alaves) is replaced by Carlos Vicente.
46' Eduardo Coudet has made a change at the break. Lucas Boye has come on in place of Denis Suarez (Alaves).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Denis Suarez (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
45+2' David Costas (Real Oviedo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' David Costas (Real Oviedo) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45' Oviedo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

44' Josip Brekalo (Real Oviedo) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Oviedo can continue in their attacking effort.
42' Denis Suarez (Alaves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
37' A cross into the box from Carles Alena (Alaves) is cleared.
36' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) picks up an injury.
32' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Calebe (Alaves) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Aaron Escandell has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
29' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Calebe (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
26' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
25' Oviedo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pablo Ibanez (Alaves).
20' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece.
19' The free kick is delivered by Josip Brekalo (Real Oviedo) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
18' Neat passing move from Oviedo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Oviedo comes to nothing.
13' Golden opportunity! Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
10' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul.
9' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
8' Oviedo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
2' The resulting set piece from Oviedo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
